steps.desc: Build and link the dirty Detcore LiteInst preload only; no guest execution
steps.cmd: set -eu; : "${LITEINST_BUILD_CHECKOUT:?set the writer-owned checkout}"; : "${LITEINST_BUILD_TARGET:?set a private external target directory}"; cd "$LITEINST_BUILD_CHECKOUT"; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short; CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$LITEINST_BUILD_TARGET" CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo build --locked --offline -j2 --manifest-path liteinst-runtime-build/Cargo.toml -p hermit-liteinst-detcore-runtime --lib
